ns0:svg.ns0:text: Real UK employer training spend per employee fell from £2,410 in 2011 to £1,700 in 2024 (−29.5%). The survey-
derived trained-employee share nevertheless rose from about 60.2% in 2022 to 62.8% in 2024. In 2024, spend per
employee ranged from £920 in Public Administration to £2,630 in Construction.
These are aggregate employer-survey statistics. They do not identify individual workers, training quality,
causal returns to training, or service-time/queue mechanisms. The coverage measure is derived as reported
